coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket of the PRMT5 inhibitor BMS-986504 (navlimetostat named in the record) in MTAP-deleted tumours. GBM appears only in keywords; the TMZ + radiotherapy cohort (Part 2 Cohort 4) and RANO v2 criteria suggest a GBM cohort but GBM is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so S5 coded not_glioblastoma and flagged. BMS-986504 role differs across arms: sole investigational agent in Part 1 and Cohorts 1 (with chemo; pumitamig is however investigational), 3 and 4, experimental_combination with daraxonrasib (Cohorts 2a-c) and pumitamig (Cohort 1); coded experimental_monotherapy for its dominant role. Nab-paclitaxel mapped to paclitaxel with new_formulation. Nivolumab + relatlimab FDC split into components. CDKN2A appears only as a keyword (not recorded). PK sample type not stated (unclear); pharmacodynamics stated as an objective without detail.
